newsitem.title: USA: Fed buys bills, adds permanent reserves to system.
newsitem.headline: Fed buys bills, adds permanent reserves to system.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added permanet reserves to the banking system on Wednesday through a bill pass operation, a Fed spokesman said.
The central bank entered the market buying bills from November 14, 1996 through October 16, 1997 for next day delivery, the spokesman said.
The Fed's move came as no surprise to Wall Street analysts, who were already expecting the central bank to add reserves to meet high demand for cash ahead of the upcoming holiday season.
